newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank o/n rates, one-week up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank o/n rates, one-week up.

text.p: The range of overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Sunday in a short start-of-the week private sector market to between eight and 8-3/4 percent from Thursday's range of 6-3/4 and 8-1/2 percent, bankers said.
The one-week range also rose to between eight and 8-3/4 percent from 7-1/4 and 8-1/2 percent on Thursday, they added.
Bankers said that public sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
